statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-3276: unicodedata.normalize() sorted runs of combining characters with a quadratic algorithm, so crafted input with long runs of alternating canonical combining classes could take excessive CPU time in every normalization form. Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/149079 (3.12 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/d3ab945af25b28dfe13ac6cb40c124a01b33ce1f), first released in CPython 3.12.14; see the advisory https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/PP5HB4K7727OBBM76KA2ILID76K3OZGZ/ and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-3276. The DHI Alpine 3.23 python-3.12 package first ships the fix in 3.12.14-r1, built from CPython 3.12.14 (the interpreter reports 3.12.14). Timed unicodedata.normalize('NFD') on 'a' followed by 5,000 alternating U+0301 and U+0316 pairs with the interpreter from every published build (3.12.12-r0 to 3.12.16-r4) on x86_64 and aarch64, running the arm64 binaries natively and the x86-64 binaries under emulation: 3.12.12-r0 to 3.12.13-r13 took 35.6 ms to 45.2 ms natively and 342.7 ms to 385.7 ms under emulation; 3.12.14-r1 and later took 0.1 ms natively and at most 0.8 ms under emulation.

CVE-2026-3276: unicodedata.normalize() sorted runs of combining characters with a quadratic algorithm, so crafted input with long runs of combining characters with alternating canonical combining classes could take excessive CPU time in every normalization form. Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/149079 (3.13 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/ba785b88add96acbf403d65cb157fb2743a33a32), first released in CPython 3.13.14; see the advisory https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/PP5HB4K7727OBBM76KA2ILID76K3OZGZ/ and https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-3276. Each build carries the CPython release named by its version, as the version string in libpython3.13 shows. We read the debug symbols of the unicodedata extension module in every published build of the DHI Alpine 3.23 python-3.13 package (3.13.12-r0 to 3.13.18-r4, x86_64 and aarch64), from the python-3.13-dbg package: the builds before 3.13.14-r0 carry CPython 3.13.13 or older and their unicodedata module has none of the canonical-ordering sort functions the fix adds, while every build from 3.13.14-r0 on carries 3.13.14 or later and has them. The range ends at 3.13.14-r0, the first build with the fix.
